newsitem.title: UK: WF Electrical up on strong interim results.
newsitem.headline: WF Electrical up on strong interim results.

text.p: Shares in WF Electrical Plc jumped on Friday after the company posted a sharp rise in first-half profits and said there were signs of a recovery in demand from recent tough conditions.
The stock was up 20p at 565p by 1106 GMT.

WF Electrical said its pre-tax profits rose 37 percent to 3.03 million stg in the six months to 31 October 1996, on sales up 20 percent at 55 million. The dividend was raised 14 percent to 4.0p per share.

"These are encouraging results despite a particularly depressed and competitive market," said managing director Richard Rose. "However, there are now early signs of a slight recovery in the level of demand."
"I am pleased to report that out progress is continuing into the second half of the current financial year."
